1.1.1.en: Lock/unlock tiles now update immediately instead of waiting on TTLock's gateway relay; fixed webhook registration for real-time sensor updates.

1.1.2.en: Reduced TTLock API usage with tiered polling: lock state is re-checked every 30 minutes and battery/settings every 6 hours (both adjustable in device settings), keeping multi-lock accounts within the free API quota. Added flow triggers: lock was locked/unlocked (with operator and method), tamper alert, and too many invalid attempts.

1.1.3.en: Fixed the app icon not showing in the App Store, and targeted Homey Pro only.

1.1.4.en: Redrawn app icon as an outline so it displays correctly in the App Store.
